steps.title: Prepare a page and its offers for Target
items: 1 · Mark the sections Target may change
2 · Write each offer as a fragment

steps.caption: The offers page: Target will test its hero and personalize a welcome strip
Section metadata names the Target location: **mbox** offers-hero
The welcome strip gets its own location, **offers-welcome**
At the top of the page metadata, **Target: on** turns personalization on
The challenger hero is a fragment, written like any other page
**Prepare** › **Send to Adobe Target** makes it a Target offer
The welcome for first-time visitors is a fragment too
Send it to Target the same way

steps.title: Authors own the content
items: mbox rows mark what Target may change
Offers are fragments in Experience Workspace
Send to Adobe Target keeps them in sync
